description: This file contains core collection interfaces, data structures, and utility functions used within the ANTLR Go runtime, including custom hash-based collections and context management for parsing.

classes.name: CollectionDescriptor
classes.description: Describes a collection type with a symbolic name and description.

classes.name: JStore
classes.description: A custom hash-based collection that stores values with hash conflict resolution, used for internal runtime data management.

classes.name: JMap
classes.description: A hash map implementation supporting custom key comparison, used for internal runtime data management.

classes.name: JPCMap
classes.description: A specialized map for PredictionContext objects, supporting nested maps for context caching.

classes.name: JPCMap2
classes.description: A hash map for PredictionContext objects with composite key hashing, supporting efficient context lookups.

classes.name: VisitEntry
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair for PredictionContext objects in visit records.

classes.name: VisitRecord
classes.description: A record for tracking visited PredictionContext objects, with pooling for reuse.

classes.name: VisitList
classes.description: A thread-safe pool of VisitRecord instances for efficient reuse.

methods.name: NewJStore
methods.description: Creates a new JStore with a specified comparator, collection type, and description.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Stores a value in the collection, returning existing if duplicate.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from the collection.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the collection.

methods.name: SortedSlice
methods.description: Returns the collection's values sorted according to a provided less function.

methods.name: Each
methods.description: Iterates over all values, applying a function.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the collection.

methods.name: Values
methods.description: Returns all values in the collection as a slice.

methods.name: NewJMap
methods.description: Creates a new JMap with a specified comparator, collection type, and description.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair in the map.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key from the map.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value from the map.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the map.

methods.name: NewJPCMap
methods.description: Creates a new PredictionContext map for caching contexts.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Stores a PredictionContext in the nested map structure.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a PredictionContext from the nested map structure.

methods.name: NewJPCMap2
methods.description: Creates a new hash map for PredictionContext objects with composite key hashing.

methods.name: dHash
methods.description: Computes a combined hash for two PredictionContext objects.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a PredictionContext from the JPCMap2 based on two keys.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Stores a PredictionContext in the JPCMap2 with two keys.

methods.name: NewVisitRecord
methods.description: Obtains a VisitRecord instance from the pool for tracking visited contexts.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a VisitRecord back to the pool.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a PredictionContext from a VisitRecord.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Stores a PredictionContext in a VisitRecord.
